info.title: SkillSpan API
info.description: SkillSpan Backend API — learner profiles, skills, evidence, readiness, intelligence decisions, career roles, projects, mentoring and administration. All routes below are the ones actually registered in routes/api.php.

servers.description: SkillSpan API (Laravel) — same origin as this documentation

get.description: Returns organization (company / university / training partner) registration requests, newest first, with the reviewing administrator eager-loaded as `verifier`. Optionally filtered by verification status; any other status value is ignored rather than rejected. Server-side paginated. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by verification status. Values outside the enum are ignored.

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

get.description: Returns a single organization request, including the reviewer and a link to the uploaded proof document so the administrator can review it before deciding. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

verified_by.description: The reviewing administrator, or null while still pending.

proof_file.description: The registration certificate, or null when none was submitted.

available.description: Whether the file is still present on the configured disk.

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

404.description: The requested organization does not exist.

get.description: Streams the organization's registration certificate. The response `Content-Type` is the stored `mime_type` of the file (for example `application/pdf` or `image/png`), not always `application/octet-stream`. Returns 404 when the organization has no proof record or the file is no longer present on the configured disk. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

200.description: The proof document streamed as a binary file (Content-Type reflects the stored mime type).

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

404.description: The organization does not exist, or it has no proof document available on disk.

post.summary: Approve an organization registration request
post.description: Marks the organization `verified`, records the reviewing administrator, marks the proof document `approved`, writes an audit event and notifies the organization's administrators by email. Only a `pending` organization can be approved; an already-reviewed one returns 422. An organization with no proof document cannot be approved. Takes no request body. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

message.example: The organization has been approved successfully.

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

404.description: The requested organization does not exist.

422.description: The organization has already been reviewed, or it has no proof document to approve.

message.example: This organization has already been reviewed.

post.summary: Reject an organization registration request
post.description: Marks the organization `rejected`, marks the proof document `rejected`, records the optional reason in the audit trail and notifies the organization's administrators by email. Only a `pending` organization can be rejected; an already-reviewed one returns 422. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

reason.example: The uploaded certificate is not legible.

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

404.description: The requested organization does not exist.

422.description: Validation error (reason too long), or the organization has already been reviewed.

get.summary: List every project with search, filters and status statistics
get.description: Returns every project in the system, newest first, with the relations the admin screen renders, plus counts for the summary cards and an echo of the applied filters. Search `q` matches title, domain or role (case-insensitive) and accepts a numeric id. Unknown filter values are ignored. Server-side paginated (`per_page` is clamped to 1–100, default 15). Each project also carries the admin-only `is_editable`, `project_roles` and `eligibility_constraints` fields. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search across title, domain and role (LIKE). A numeric value also matches the project id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the project type. Other values are ignored.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the project status. `closed` is accepted only so a legacy row stays findable.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the difficulty level (numeric).

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Filter to projects belonging to this organization (numeric).

200.description: Projects retrieved, with statistics and the applied filters.

data.description: Laravel paginator of ProjectResource items, each decorated with the admin-only fields.

is_editable.description: Whether the project is in an editable status (draft or changes_requested).

project_roles.description: EVERY stored project role, including inactive ones.

eligibility_constraints.description: The stored eligibility constraint rows (not the per-learner verdict).

stats.description: Whole-table counts, independent of the active filters.

filters.description: The filters that were actually applied (empty values omitted).

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

post.summary: Create a project from the admin panel (starts as a draft)
post.description: Creates a project using the same form request and lifecycle service as the owner API, so validation rules and the "starts as draft" rule do not fork. The project always starts as `draft`. `organization_id` and `owner_id` are only honoured when a platform administrator creates a company_sponsored project on behalf of a company; otherwise they are ignored. Date ordering (end >= start, deadline <= start) is validated by the service against the final state. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

description.example: Modernise the checkout API of a legacy e-commerce platform.

objectives.example: Ship a documented, tested v2 checkout API.

organization_id.description: Must exist in organizations.id. Only honoured for a platform administrator creating a company_sponsored project.

owner_id.description: Must exist in users.id. Only honoured for a platform administrator creating a company_sponsored project; the owner must be an active administrator of the sponsoring organization.

skill_id.description: Must exist in skills.id; must be distinct across entries.

403.description: The caller may not create projects, or may not administer the named organization (codes PROJECT_CREATE_FORBIDDEN, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_NOT_ADMINISTERED).

422.description: Validation error, or a business-rule failure such as PROJECT_TYPE_INVALID, PROJECT_OWNER_REQUIRED, PROJECT_OWNER_INVALID, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_COMPANY, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_NOT_VERIFIED or PROJECT_INVALID_DATES.

get.summary: Retrieve one project with admin details
get.description: Returns a single project with the relations the detail screen renders, plus the admin-only `is_editable`, `project_roles` and `eligibility_constraints` fields. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

403.description: Authenticated account is not an administrator.

404.description: The requested project does not exist (code PROJECT_NOT_FOUND).

patch.summary: Update a project from the admin panel
patch.description: Partially updates a project. Every top-level field is optional, so an omitted field is left untouched; supplying a child set (required_skills, roles, eligibility_constraints) replaces it wholesale. Only a project in `draft` or `changes_requested` may be edited; an approved or open project is refused with PROJECT_NOT_EDITABLE. Authorization (owner or platform administrator) is enforced by ProjectLifecycleService. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

organization_id.description: Only honoured when the type changes and a platform administrator updates a company_sponsored project.

owner_id.description: Only honoured when the type changes.

skill_id.description: Must exist in skills.id; must be distinct across entries.

403.description: The caller is not the project owner, or may not link the named organization (codes PROJECT_NOT_OWNED, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_NOT_ADMINISTERED, PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED).

404.description: The requested project does not exist (code PROJECT_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The project status changed while the request was being processed (code PROJECT_STATUS_CONFLICT).

422.description: Validation error, or a business-rule failure such as PROJECT_NOT_EDITABLE or PROJECT_INVALID_DATES.

post.summary: Cancel a project (soft delete)
post.description: Marks a project `cancelled`, preserving its applications, recommendations and audit trail. This is not a general status editor: it accepts no target status, so the only reachable transition is the one defined here. An optional `reason` is forwarded to ProjectLifecycleService and recorded. A project that has already reached a final state (cancelled/archived) is reported as such rather than silently re-cancelled. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + admin.

403.description: The caller is not the project owner or a platform administrator (code PROJECT_NOT_OWNED).

404.description: The requested project does not exist (code PROJECT_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The project has already reached a final state, or its status changed while the request was being processed (code PROJECT_STATUS_CONFLICT).

422.description: The transition is not allowed (code PROJECT_INVALID_TRANSITION).

post.summary: Register an individual learner account
post.description: Creates an individual (learner) account, stores the terms/privacy acceptance timestamps and sends an email verification code (OTP). The account stays inactive until it is verified. Throttled to 10 requests per minute.

email.description: Must be unique and not a disposable domain.

message.example: Your account has been created successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.

422.description: Validation error (duplicate email, disposable email, weak password, …).

post.summary: Register an organization account
post.description: Creates a company / university / training-partner account. A proof document (`proof_file`) is mandatory and is reviewed by an administrator before the account is activated. This flow deliberately does NOT use an email OTP. Throttled to 10 requests per minute.

201.description: Organization account created; pending administrator review.

message.example: Your organization account has been created successfully. Your proof document will be reviewed by an administrator before your account is activated.

422.description: Validation error.

post.summary: Verify the email OTP and activate the account
post.description: Validates the 6-digit code sent by email. Unknown emails and wrong codes return the same "invalid or expired" outcome so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts.

200.description: Account activated (or email confirmed for an organization member).

message.example: Your account has been activated successfully. You can now log in.

422.description: Invalid or expired code.

post.summary: Resend the email verification code
post.description: Always returns the same neutral response regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking registered addresses. Rate limited to one resend per interval.

message.example: If an account with that email exists, a new verification code has been sent.

422.description: Validation error.

post.summary: Log in (individual accounts)
post.description: Authenticates an account and issues a Sanctum bearer token. After 5 failed attempts the caller is locked out for 5 minutes (HTTP 429 with Retry-After). Throttled to 20 requests per minute.

422.description: Invalid credentials or inactive account.

post.summary: Log in or register with Google
post.description: Verifies a Google ID token server-side, then logs in or creates an individual learner account. Consent flags are only enforced on the account-creation path.

credential.description: Google ID token returned by Google Identity Services.

422.description: Invalid Google credential.

post.summary: Log in (organization administrator accounts)
post.description: Organization-scoped login. Rejects individual accounts, and blocks accounts whose organization is still pending or rejected. Throttled to 20 requests per minute.

422.description: Not an organization account, pending/rejected organization, or invalid credentials.

post.summary: Request a password reset code
post.description: Sends a password reset code when the account exists; the response is always the same neutral shape. Rate limited per account.

message.example: If an account with that email exists, a password reset code has been sent.

422.description: Validation error.

post.summary: Resend the password reset code
post.description: Re-sends the reset code while respecting the resend interval. Always neutral.

message.example: If an account with that email exists, a password reset code has been sent.

422.description: Validation error.

post.summary: Verify the password reset code (without consuming it)
post.description: Checks that the reset code is valid so the frontend can move to the "set new password" screen. The code is not consumed here; consumption happens in `/auth/reset-password`.

message.example: Code verified. You can now set a new password.

422.description: Invalid or expired code.

post.summary: Reset the password using the emailed code
post.description: Validates the reset code and updates the account password.

message.example: Your password has been reset successfully. You can now log in.

422.description: Invalid or expired code.

post.summary: Log out of the current device
post.description: Revokes only the Sanctum token used for this request and marks the matching auth session revoked. Requires authentication.

post.summary: Log out of all devices
post.description: Revokes every Sanctum token belonging to the user, including the one used for this request, and records the revocation on every active auth session.

message.example: You have been logged out from all devices.

post.summary: Create (or return) the conversation for a connection
post.description: Creates the conversation that belongs to a mentor-student connection. Idempotent: if an active conversation already exists for the connection it is returned unchanged instead of creating a second one, so the endpoint is safe to call repeatedly. The caller must be one of the two participants of the connection, otherwise 403. The connection must still be `pending` or `active`; a disconnected connection returns 422. No request body is accepted — the conversation is derived entirely from the connection. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: Id of the mentor-student connection the conversation belongs to.

201.description: Conversation created (or the existing active conversation returned).

403.description: The caller is not a participant in this connection (`NOT_A_PARTICIPANT`).

404.description: The connection does not exist.

422.description: The connection is no longer active (`CONNECTION_NOT_ACTIVE`).

get.description: Returns the active conversations the authenticated user participates in, either as mentor or as student, most recently active first (`last_message_at` descending). Each conversation includes its connection and the two participants. Results are paginated using the configured page size. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

403.description: The account is not active.

get.description: Returns one conversation together with its connection. The caller must be one of the two participants, otherwise 403 (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

get.summary: List the messages of a conversation
get.description: Returns the conversation messages, newest first, paginated. The caller must be a participant (403). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation
post.description: Posts a human message into a conversation and notifies the other participant (honouring their notification preferences). The caller must be a participant (403) and the conversation must still be active (422). The body is validated against the configured `communication.message_max_length` and is also re-checked in the service. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

parameters.name: conversation
parameters.description: Id of the conversation to post into.

body.example: Hi! Ready for our session tomorrow?

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

422.description: Validation failure (missing/too-long body, invalid message_type), or the conversation is no longer active (`CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE` / `MESSAGE_TOO_LONG`).

post.summary: Mark the conversation messages as read
post.description: Marks every unread message sent by the other participant as read (setting `read_at` and `read_by` to the caller) and returns how many rows were affected. The caller must be a participant (403). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active. No request body is required.

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

get.summary: Get the communication status of a conversation
get.description: Returns a lightweight status summary: the conversation state, the number of messages from the other participant that the caller has not read yet, the last message timestamp and a short preview, and when the conversation retention window expires. The caller must be a participant (403). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

last_message_preview.example: Hi! Ready for our session tomorrow?

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

get.summary: List the chatbot messages of a conversation
get.description: Returns only the messages with `message_type` = `chatbot` in the conversation, newest first, paginated. The caller must be a participant (403). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

post.summary: Post an automated chatbot message into a conversation
post.description: Posts an automated message into a conversation. The message is always stored with `message_type` = `chatbot` — the client cannot override it — and the metadata is merged with `source` so automated traffic stays separable from human messages in both the API and the audit trail. The other participant is notified (honouring their preferences). The caller must be a participant (403) and the conversation must still be active (422). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

parameters.name: conversation
parameters.description: Id of the conversation to post into.

body.example: Reminder: your next mentoring session is tomorrow at 10:00.

source.description: Optional tag stored under `metadata.source`; defaults to `chatbot`.

403.description: The caller is not a participant of this conversation (`UNAUTHORIZED_CONVERSATION`).

404.description: The conversation does not exist.

422.description: Validation failure (missing/too-long body, invalid source), or the conversation is no longer active (`CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE` / `MESSAGE_TOO_LONG`).

get.summary: List verified evidence for the authenticated learner
get.description: Returns only the evidence records whose `verification_status` is `verified`, belonging to the authenticated learner's student profile, with the related skill and reviewer eager-loaded.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not a learner.

422.description: The account has no student profile yet.

post.summary: Submit evidence for a skill
post.description: Creates a new evidence record for the authenticated learner, linked to an active skill. The record is stored as `pending` until an administrator reviews it. Either `evidence_url` or an uploaded `evidence_file` must be supplied. Submitting a combination of learner, skill, source (`certificate`) and reference that already exists is rejected as a duplicate.

skill_id.description: Must reference an existing skill whose status is `active`.

evidence_file.description: Required when `evidence_url` is not sent. Maximum 10000 KB.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not a learner.

409.description: Duplicate evidence already exists for this skill.

422.description: Validation error, or the account has no student profile (`success`/`message` envelope).

get.description: Administrators can access any evidence record. Other users can only access evidence that belongs to their own student profile — the ownership check is part of the query, so another learner's record is indistinguishable from a missing one (404).

404.description: Evidence record not found, or not owned by the caller.

422.description: The account has no student profile yet.

put.description: Marks an evidence record as `verified` or `rejected`, records the reviewer and optional notes, recalculates the learner's skill level and confidence synchronously, and dispatches a queued intelligence recalculation for the learner.

reviewer_notes.example: Certificate verified against the issuer registry.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not an administrator.

404.description: Evidence record not found.

422.description: Validation error (invalid or missing `verification_status`).

get.description: Returns approved career roles ordered by version (descending) with a deterministic `id` tie-breaker, paginated at a fixed 15 items per page. Each item carries a `skills_count`. The response echoes (or generates) a `request_id`, also returned in the `X-Request-ID` header. When `specialization_id` is supplied, only the approved career roles linked to that specialization (via the career_role_specialization pivot) are returned — this is the filter the frontend uses to drive the specialization -> career role -> skills -> questions flow. The "Self-Learning / Free Track" specialization is the exception: it carries no pivot rows and returns EVERY approved career role, so a self-taught learner can pick any role. Omitting the filter preserves the original "list every approved role" behaviour.

parameters.name: specialization_id
parameters.description: Optional filter. Must be a positive integer referencing an existing specialization. When present, only approved career roles linked to that specialization are returned — except for the "Self-Learning / Free Track", which returns every approved role. When omitted, every approved career role is returned (unchanged behaviour).

data.description: Laravel length-aware paginator (per page fixed at 15).
Each item is a CareerRole plus a `skills_count`.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not a learner.

422.description: Validation error — `specialization_id` is not a positive integer or does not reference an existing specialization.

get.description: Returns a single approved career role. Only approved roles are visible through this API; an unknown id returns `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_FOUND`, while an existing but non-approved role returns `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_APPROVED`. The response echoes a `request_id`.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not a learner.

404.description: `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_FOUND` — the career role does not exist.

422.description: `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_APPROVED` — the career role exists but is not approved.

get.summary: Retrieve the career role decision snapshot
get.description: Returns the point-in-time decision snapshot for an approved role: its required skills with required level, importance weight, critical flag and prerequisites, plus aggregate statistics and snapshot metadata. Unknown ids return `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_FOUND`, non-approved roles return `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_APPROVED`, and an approved role without required skills returns `CAREER_ROLE_NO_SKILLS`. The response echoes a `request_id`.

message.example: Career role decision snapshot prepared successfully.

403.description: Forbidden — the account is not a learner.

404.description: `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_FOUND` — the career role does not exist.

422.description: `CAREER_ROLE_NOT_APPROVED` (role exists but is not approved) or `CAREER_ROLE_NO_SKILLS` (approved role has no required skills).

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own notifications, newest first, paginated (20 per page). Every row is scoped to the caller's user_id, so a user can never read another user's feed. Requires an active account.

parameters.name: unread_only
parameters.description: When truthy, only unread notifications are returned.

403.description: Account is not active.

get.summary: Get the caller's unread notification count
get.description: Cheap polling endpoint for the unread badge. Optionally scoped to a single category. Requires an active account.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Count unread notifications in this category only.

403.description: Account is not active.

post.summary: Mark all of the caller's notifications as read
post.description: Marks every unread notification belonging to the authenticated user as read, optionally limited to a single category. Returns how many rows were affected. Requires an active account.

category.description: Only mark unread notifications in this category.

403.description: Account is not active.

get.summary: List the caller's explicit notification preferences
get.description: Returns the explicit preference rows for the authenticated user (rows only, not defaults — absence of a row means the category/channel is enabled). Ordered by category. Requires an active account.

403.description: Account is not active.

put.description: Creates or updates the preference row for the given category/channel pair. Channels are constrained to the ones the system actually dispatches on. Requires an active account.

403.description: Account is not active.

422.description: Validation error (unknown channel, missing fields, …).

post.summary: Mark one notification as read
post.description: Marks a single notification belonging to the authenticated user as read. The row is matched by id AND user_id, so a notification that does not exist or belongs to someone else returns the same 404. Requires an active account.

404.description: The specified notification was not found (or belongs to another user).

message.example: The specified notification was not found.

post.summary: Create an administrator account (bootstrap)
post.description: Permanent bootstrap endpoint for creating admin accounts. It is gated by the ADMIN_SETUP_SECRET environment value supplied as the `secret` body field — this is NOT Sanctum authentication and the endpoint is public. The account is created active and email-verified, granted the `admin` role, and a bearer token is returned. Throttled to 5 requests per minute.

message.example: Admin account created successfully. Save this token now, or log in normally afterwards via /api/v1/auth/login.

403.description: Setup disabled (no ADMIN_SETUP_SECRET configured) or invalid secret.

422.description: Validation error.

message.example: The email has already been taken.

post.summary: Create or promote a mentor account (bootstrap)
post.description: Bootstrap endpoint gated by the MENTOR_SETUP_SECRET environment value supplied as the `secret` body field — NOT Sanctum, and public. A missing email creates a new active, email-verified account; a `pending` account is activated; an `active` account is promoted. Soft-deleted / suspended / deleted accounts are rejected with 422. The user's ProfessionalProfile is set to type=mentor with verification_status=verified. If `password` is supplied it always replaces the existing one (admin password-reset path); when omitted, an existing password is left unchanged, while a newly created account gets a generated password echoed back once. Throttled to 10 requests per minute.

201.description: Mentor account created and/or promoted and verified.

message.example: Mentor profile created successfully. This user can now access the mentor endpoints.

generated_password.description: Only populated when the password was minted by the server.

403.description: Setup disabled (no MENTOR_SETUP_SECRET configured) or invalid secret.

422.description: Validation error, or the existing account is suspended/deleted.

message.example: An account with this email already exists and its status is suspended. Restore or reactivate it before promoting it to mentor.

get.description: Server-to-server endpoint consumed by the Data Science FastAPI service. The backend is the source of truth for assessment content, so this returns each active item together with its skill mapping and correct answer. Authenticated with the shared-secret header `X-Internal-Secret` (NOT Sanctum). Throttled to 60 requests per minute.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Secret
parameters.description: Shared internal secret. Compared in constant time.

200.description: Baseline items for the requested version.

question_text.example: Which HTTP status code means "Not Found"?

422.description: Validation error (missing version).

get.summary: Get the authenticated organization admin's profile
get.description: Returns the profile of the organization the caller actively administers. The organization used for the payload and the one that establishes admin rights are the same row: the caller must be an `admin` member (pivot `role_in_org`) whose membership status is `active`. A caller with no organization at all receives 403 "This account is not linked to any organization."; a caller who is not an active admin of one receives 403 "Only an organization admin can view this profile." Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + organization.approved.

403.description: The account is not linked to any organization, or the caller is not an active admin of one.

get.summary: List students the mentor is permitted to see
get.description: Returns every student profile the mentor is allowed to view. Visibility rules (enforced in the service): students with an active/pending connection to this mentor, students whose profile visibility is `public`, and students whose visibility is `organization_only` when they share an active organization membership with the mentor. No query filters are supported. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + mentor (verified ProfessionalProfile of type `mentor`).

403.description: The caller is not a verified mentor.

get.description: Returns the summary of a single student, provided the mentor is permitted to see them (active/pending connection, `public` visibility, or a shared active organization for `organization_only` profiles). Returns 403 (code STUDENT_NOT_VISIBLE) when the mentor is not permitted, and 422 (code STUDENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND) when the user has no student profile. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + mentor.

403.description: Not permitted to view this student (code STUDENT_NOT_VISIBLE) or not a verified mentor.

422.description: The specified student does not have a student profile (code STUDENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND).

get.description: Returns the authenticated mentor's connections, newest first, paginated at 20 per page, with each connection's student profile and project eager-loaded. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + mentor.

403.description: The caller is not a verified mentor.

post.summary: Create a mentor-student connection
post.description: Creates a connection between the authenticated mentor and a student, optionally scoped to a project. The connection is created with status `pending`. Only a verified mentor may create connections (403, code MENTOR_ONLY). When a `project_id` is supplied the project must exist (404, code PROJECT_NOT_FOUND) and pass availability (422, codes PROJECT_NOT_AVAILABLE / PROJECT_DEADLINE_PASSED / PROJECT_CAPACITY_REACHED) and eligibility (422, code PROJECT_ELIGIBILITY_FAILED) checks. Duplicate connections are rejected with 422 (code DUPLICATE_CONNECTION). Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + mentor.

project_id.description: Optional project to scope the connection to; must reference an existing project.

403.description: Only verified mentors can create connections (code MENTOR_ONLY).

404.description: The specified project does not exist (code PROJECT_NOT_FOUND).

422.description: Validation error, missing student profile (STUDENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND), duplicate connection (DUPLICATE_CONNECTION), or a project availability/eligibility failure (PROJECT_NOT_AVAILABLE, PROJECT_DEADLINE_PASSED, PROJECT_CAPACITY_REACHED, PROJECT_ELIGIBILITY_FAILED).

patch.description: Accepts, disconnects or archives a connection. Setting the status to `disconnected` also records `disconnected_reason` and `disconnected_at`. The other party is notified for `active` and `disconnected` transitions. Returns 404 when the connection id does not exist. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + mentor.

reason.description: Optional reason; stored as the disconnected reason when status is `disconnected`.

403.description: The caller is not a verified mentor.

404.description: The specified connection does not exist.

422.description: Validation error (missing/invalid `status`, or `reason` longer than 500 characters).

get.description: Returns one project the authenticated learner is authorized to see. This is the only endpoint that attaches the per-learner `eligibility` and `capacity_state` blocks (computed by ProjectEligibilityService and ProjectCapacityPolicy respectively). patch.description: Partially updates a project the caller manages. Every top-level field is optional, so an omitted field is left untouched; supplying a child set (required_skills, roles, eligibility_constraints) replaces it wholesale. Only a project in a draft or changes_requested state may be edited. `type`, `organization_id` and `owner_id` are only re-evaluated when the type actually changes. The `version` column is bumped only when a matching-relevant field changed. Authorization (owner or platform admin) is enforced by ProjectLifecycleService. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active.

post.summary: Calculate the project matching recommendation for the authenticated learner
post.description: Calculates and persists a deterministic matching recommendation for the authenticated learner and the given project. It takes no request body: the only input is the route parameter. The service validates availability, authorization and eligibility, builds an immutable snapshot, calls the Data Science matching service and stores the validated result. The matching integration is gated on the DATA_SCIENCE_PROJECT_MATCHING_ENABLED flag: when it is disabled the endpoint returns 503 (code INTELLIGENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED) rather than a fabricated result. The top-level `request_id` is the caller's X-Request-ID, while `data.request_id` is the snapshot correlation id sent to the Data Science service. Protected by auth:sanctum + account.active + role:learner.

The "Self-Learning / Free Track" specialization accepts any existing career role. Omitting it keeps the original `career_role_id`-only contract. Requires the `learner` role.

Only the learner who owns the recommendation may submit feedback. No suppression window is applied — only the event is recorded.
